questions.text:
पिछले काफी वर्षों से एक बहुराष्ट्रीय कम्पनी मिठाइयों एवं नाश्ते के खान-पान व्यवसाय में है । दीर्घ अवधि में अपनी संभावनाओं में वृद्धि एवं विकास के लिए यह अपनी विक्रय मात्रा, उत्पादों की संख्या तथा पूँजी निवेश में वृद्धि करना चाहती है ।

प्रबन्ध का वह संगठनात्मक उद्देश्य जिसे यह प्राप्त करना चाहते हैं :
questions.text_english:
A multinational sweets and snacks company had been into catering business for the last many years. To add to its prospects and to grow in the long run, it wants to increase its sales volume, the number of products and capital investment.

The organisational objective of management it seeks to achieve is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Growth. The company wants to increase its sales volume, number of products, and capital investment — all of which are indicators of organizational growth as a management objective. Survival relates to just staying in business, Profit focuses on earnings, and Corporate Social Responsibility relates to social obligations — none of these describe the expansion intent stated in the question.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) बढ़ोतरी है। कम्पनी अपनी विक्रय मात्रा, उत्पादों की संख्या तथा पूँजी निवेश में वृद्धि करना चाहती है जो कि बढ़ोतरी के संगठनात्मक उद्देश्य को दर्शाता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से प्रबन्ध के स्तरों के सम्बन्ध में गलत कथन का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: With respect to levels of management choose the incorrect statement from the following :

options.A: प्रचालन स्तर प्रबंधन संगठन में सुरक्षा मानकों को बनाए रखने के लिए उत्तरदायी हैं ।
options.B: मध्य स्तरीय प्रबंधन पर प्रबन्धक अपने विभाग के लिए कर्मचारियों की पर्याप्त संख्या सुनिश्चित करते हैं ।
options.C: उच्च स्तरीय प्रबंधन पर मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी प्रथम रेखीय प्रबन्धकों की सभी गतिविधियों के लिए उत्तरदायी होते हैं ।
options.D: उच्च स्तरीय प्रबंधन व्यवसाय की समस्त गतिविधियों एवं समाज पर उसके प्रभाव के लिए उत्तरदायी होते हैं ।

options_english.A: Operational level management is responsible for maintaining safety standards in the organisation.
options_english.B: At middle level management, managers ensure that their department has the necessary personnel.
options_english.C: Chief Executive Officer at Top Level management is responsible for all activities of first line managers.
options_english.D: Top level management is responsible for all the activities of the business and for its impact on the society.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). The statement that the CEO at Top Level management is responsible for all activities of first line managers is incorrect. The CEO and top-level management are responsible for setting overall goals and policies, not for directly supervising or being accountable for all the activities of first-line (operational) managers. Options A, B, and D are all correct statements about their respective levels of management.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी प्रथम रेखीय प्रबन्धकों की सभी गतिविधियों के लिए सीधे उत्तरदायी नहीं होते — यह कथन गलत है। उच्च स्तरीय प्रबंधन संपूर्ण व्यवसाय के लक्ष्य एवं नीतियाँ निर्धारित करता है।

questions.text:
'केवल कार्य का आबंटन मात्र ही पर्याप्त नहीं होता । प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को यह ज्ञात होना चाहिए कि उसे किससे आदेश प्राप्त करने हैं और वह किसके प्रति जवाबदेह है ।'

उपरोक्त कथन संगठन प्रक्रिया के एक चरण से सम्बन्धित है । निम्नलिखित में से चरण को पहचानिए :
questions.text_english:
'Merely allocating work is not enough. Each individual should also know who he has to take orders from and to whom he is accountable'.

The above statement is related to one of the steps of organising process. Identify the step from the following :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Establishing authority and reporting relationship. The statement specifically highlights that employees should know from whom they receive orders and to whom they are accountable — this directly refers to establishing authority and reporting relationships in the organising process. Options A, B, and C relate to earlier steps of identifying work, grouping activities into departments, and assigning specific duties respectively.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) प्राधिकार एवं रिपोर्टिंग संबंध स्थापन है। कथन में यह बताया गया है कि कर्मचारी को यह पता होना चाहिए कि वह किसके आदेश में है और किसके प्रति जवाबदेह है, जो संगठन प्रक्रिया के इसी चरण को दर्शाता है।
questions.topic: Steps in the Process of Organising

questions.text: ________ नियंत्रण प्रक्रिया का वह चरण है जहाँ यदि प्रबन्धकों के प्रयासों से विचलनों को ठीक न किया जा सकता हो तो मानकों को संशोधित करना चाहिए ।
questions.text_english: ________ is the step in the controlling process where standards may have to be revised in case the deviation cannot be corrected through managerial action.

options.C: वास्तविक निष्पादन की मानकों से तुलना तथा विचलन विश्लेषण

options_english.C: Comparing Actual Performance with standards and analysing deviations

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Setting Performance Standards. When deviations cannot be corrected through managerial action, the standards themselves need to be revised. This revision happens at the 'Setting Performance Standards' step, as the standards may have been unrealistic or set incorrectly in the first place. Options B, C, and D are subsequent steps of measurement, comparison, and corrective action that do not involve revising standards.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) निष्पादन मानकों का निर्धारण है। जब प्रबन्धकीय प्रयासों से विचलनों को ठीक नहीं किया जा सकता, तो मानकों को संशोधित करना आवश्यक होता है, जो कि निष्पादन मानकों के निर्धारण के चरण में किया जाता है।
questions.topic: Steps in the Process of Controlling

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए । ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :

अभिकथन (A) : लाभ की मात्रा लाभांश निर्णय की मुख्य निर्धारक होती है ।

कारण (R) : लाभांश का भुगतान पूर्व एवं चालू लाभों में से किया जाता है ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct option from the given options.

Assertion (A) : Amount of Earnings is a major determinant of the decision about dividend.

Reason (R) : Dividends are paid out of current and past earnings.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Both the Assertion and Reason are true, and the Reason correctly explains the Assertion. The amount of earnings is indeed a major determinant of dividend decisions because dividends can only be paid out of current and past earnings — if a company has low or no earnings, it cannot declare dividends. Hence, the Reason directly and logically explains why earnings determine the dividend decision.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है। लाभांश केवल वर्तमान एवं पिछले लाभों में से दिया जाता है, इसलिए लाभ की मात्रा लाभांश निर्णय की मुख्य निर्धारक होती है।

questions.text: 'यह वह प्रक्रिया है जो उपलब्ध निधियों को उनके सर्वाधिक उत्पादक निवेश अवसर में विनियोजित करती है ।' यह जानी जाती है :
questions.text_english:
'It is a process that allocates or directs funds available for investment into their most productive instrument opportunity'.

This is known as :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Allocative function. The allocative function of financial markets refers to the process by which available funds are directed or channelled into their most productive investment opportunities. Financial planning deals with estimating fund requirements; Financial Intermediation refers to the role of intermediaries in connecting savers and investors; Capital budgeting is about evaluating long-term investment decisions in a firm — none of these match the definition given.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) आवंटन कार्य है। वित्तीय बाज़ार का आवंटन कार्य उपलब्ध निधियों को सर्वाधिक उत्पादक निवेश अवसरों में लगाने की प्रक्रिया है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी प्रबन्धन के 'निर्देशन' कार्य की विशेषता नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is NOT a feature of 'Directing' function of management ?

options.A: निर्देशन क्रिया को प्रारंभ करता है ।
options.B: निर्देशन प्रबंधन के प्रत्येक स्तर पर निष्पादित होता है ।
options.C: निर्देशन यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि क्रियाओं का निष्पादन योजनानुसार हो रहा है ।
options.D: निर्देशन ऊपर से नीचे की ओर प्रवाहित होता है ।

options_english.B: Directing takes place at every level of management.
options_english.C: Directing ensures that activities are performed as per plans.
options_english.D: Directing flows from top to bottom.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). Ensuring that activities are performed as per plans is a feature of the Controlling function, not Directing. Directing initiates action (A), takes place at every level of management (B), and flows from top to bottom (D) — all of these are genuine features of directing. Controlling is the function that monitors and compares actual performance with planned performance.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। यह सुनिश्चित करना कि क्रियाएं योजनानुसार हो रही हैं — यह 'नियंत्रण' कार्य की विशेषता है, न कि निर्देशन की। निर्देशन के कार्य में क्रिया प्रारंभ करना, हर स्तर पर होना और ऊपर से नीचे प्रवाहित होना सम्मिलित है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा अनौपचारिक संगठन का एक लाभ है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is an advantage of Informal organisation ?

options.A: यह संगठन को स्थायित्व प्रदान करता है क्योंकि कर्मचारियों के व्यवहार का आसानी से पूर्वानुमान लगाया जा सकता है चूँकि उनके मार्गदर्शन के लिए स्पष्ट नियम होते हैं ।
options.B: निष्पादित की जाने वाली क्रियाकलापों का एक ढाँचा प्रदान कर यह उद्देश्यों की प्रभावपूर्ण प्राप्ति की ओर ले जाता है ।
options.C: यह कर्मचारियों की कार्य संतुष्टि में वृद्धि करता है, चूँकि इससे उनमें संगठन में अपनत्व की भावना जागृत होती है तथा उन्हें एक जैसी सोच वाले लोग ढूँढने की अनुमति प्रदान करता है ।
options.D: इससे प्रयासों की पुनरावृत्ति पर रोक लगती है क्योंकि प्रत्येक सदस्य की भूमिका में कोई अस्पष्टता नहीं होती ।

options_english.A: It provides stability to the organisation because behaviour of employees can be fairly predicted since there are specific rules to guide them.
options_english.B: It leads to effective accomplishment of goals by providing a framework for the operations to be performed.
options_english.C: It enhances the employee's job satisfaction since it gives them a sense of belongingness in the organisation and allows them to find like minded people.
options_english.D: It helps in avoiding duplication of efforts as there is no ambiguity in the role that each member has to play.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). An informal organisation enhances employees' job satisfaction by giving them a sense of belongingness and allowing them to find like-minded people, which is a genuine advantage. Options A, B, and D describe advantages of formal organisation — stability through clear rules, effective goal accomplishment through a defined framework, and avoiding duplication of efforts through clear role definition are all characteristics of formal organisations.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। अनौपचारिक संगठन का एक प्रमुख लाभ यह है कि यह कर्मचारियों में अपनत्व की भावना जागृत करता है और उनकी कार्य संतुष्टि बढ़ाता है। विकल्प A, B और D औपचारिक संगठन के लाभ हैं।

questions.text:
'मरबरी बिस्कुट्स' ने तीन किस्मों के ओट्स के बिस्कुटों की एक नई श्रृंखला का शुभारंभ किया है । अपने प्रवर्तन (संवर्धनात्मक) अभियान के एक भाग के रूप में उन्होंने विद्यालयों में अपने बिस्कुटों के मुफ्त नमूने बाँटने का निर्णय लिया ।

'मरबरी बिस्कुट्स' द्वारा उपयोग में लाई गई प्रवर्तन तकनीक को पहचानिए :
questions.text_english:
'Marbury biscuits' launched its new range of oat cookies in three varieties. They decided to distribute free samples of their biscuits in schools as a part of their promotional campaign.

Identify the tool of promotion used by 'Marbury Biscuits' :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Sales Promotion. Distributing free samples is a classic sales promotion technique used to introduce a new product and encourage trial. Advertising involves paid mass communication through media; Personal Selling involves one-on-one interaction; Public Relations involves managing the company's image with the public — none of these describe the free sample distribution mentioned in the question.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) विक्रय संवर्धन है। मुफ्त नमूने बाँटना एक विक्रय संवर्धन तकनीक है जो उत्पाद का परिचय कराने और ग्राहकों को उसे आज़माने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करने हेतु उपयोग की जाती है।

questions.text: ________ वह प्रक्रिया है जिसके द्वारा एक प्रबन्धक विभिन्न विभागों की गतिविधियों में एकात्मकता लाता है ।
questions.text_english: ________ is the process by which a manager synchronises the activities of different departments.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Co-ordination. Co-ordination is defined as the process by which a manager synchronises the activities of different departments to ensure that all efforts are directed towards the common goals of the organisation. Management is a broader concept; Planning deals with setting objectives; Directing deals with guiding and motivating employees — none of these specifically mean synchronising activities of different departments.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) समन्वय है। समन्वय वह प्रक्रिया है जिसके द्वारा प्रबन्धक विभिन्न विभागों की गतिविधियों में एकात्मकता और सामंजस्य लाता है ताकि सभी प्रयास संगठन के लक्ष्यों की दिशा में हों।

questions.text: कॉलम-I में दिए गए भारतीय प्रतिभूति एवं विनिमय बोर्ड के कार्यों का कॉलम-II में दिए गए उनके शीर्षकों से मिलान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Match the functions of Securities and Exchange Board of India given in Column-I with their headings given in Column-II :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) A(iii); B(i); C(ii). Training of intermediaries of securities markets (A) is a Development function (iii) as it helps develop the securities market. Regulation of takeover bids by companies (B) is a Regulatory function (i) as it involves making rules and regulations. Controlling insider trading and imposing penalties (C) is a Protective function (ii) as it protects investors from malpractices.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) A(iii); B(i); C(ii) है। प्रतिभूति बाज़ार के मध्यस्थों का प्रशिक्षण विकासपूर्ण कार्य है; कम्पनी की अधिग्रहण बोलियों पर नियमन नियमनकर्ता कार्य है; आंतरिक व्यापार पर नियंत्रण एवं दंड लगाना सुरक्षात्मक कार्य है।

questions.text:
वर्ष के प्रारंभ में ल्याका लिमिटेड ने अपने हर्बल शैम्पू की एक नई श्रृंखला का शुभारंभ किया । कानूनी ढाँचे के अनुसार ल्याका लिमिटेड ने हर्बल शैम्पू के पैकेज़ और लेबल पर निर्माता का नाम एवं पता, वज़न, उत्पादन तिथि, समाप्ति तिथि, अधिकतम खुदरा मूल्य आदि प्रदान किया है ।

उपरोक्त में जिस उपभोक्ता अधिकार पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, वह है :
questions.text_english:
Lyka Ltd. launched its new range of herbal shampoos at the beginning of the year. As per legal framework, Lyka Ltd. provided the name and address of the manufacturer, the weight, manufacturing date, expiry date, maximum retail price etc. on the package and label of the herbal shampoo.

The consumer right highlighted above is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Right to be informed. The right to be informed means consumers have the right to receive complete and accurate information about the product, including its name, manufacturer, ingredients, weight, manufacturing date, expiry date, and price — exactly what Lyka Ltd. provided on its label. The right to choose relates to availability of variety, right to safety is about protection from hazardous goods, and right to consumer education is about awareness of rights.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) सूचना का अधिकार है। उपभोक्ता को उत्पाद के बारे में सही एवं पूर्ण जानकारी प्राप्त करने का अधिकार है जैसे निर्माता का नाम, वज़न, उत्पादन तिथि, MRP आदि। ल्याका लिमिटेड ने यही जानकारी प्रदान की।

questions.text:
कथन – I : व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण गतिशील होता है क्योंकि यह भिन्न-भिन्न देशों में भिन्न-भिन्न होता है ।

कथन – II : व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण अधिकांशत: अनिश्चित होता है क्योंकि भविष्य की घटनाओं का पूर्वानुमान लगाना बहुत कठिन होता है ।

निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Statement – I : Business Environment is dynamic as it differs from country to country.

Statement – II : Business Environment is largely uncertain as it is very difficult to predict future happenings.

Choose the correct option from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन II सत्य है तथा कथन I असत्य है ।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement II is true and Statement I is false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B). Statement I is incorrect because while business environment is indeed dynamic, its dynamism means it keeps changing over time — not that it differs from country to country (which describes its complexity, not dynamism). Statement II is correct: business environment is largely uncertain because future events are difficult to predict, making it hard for businesses to plan with certainty.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। कथन I असत्य है — व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण गतिशील है क्योंकि यह समय के साथ बदलता रहता है, न कि इसलिए कि यह देशों में अलग-अलग है। कथन II सत्य है — भविष्य की घटनाओं का पूर्वानुमान कठिन होने के कारण व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण अनिश्चित होता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी विमुद्रीकरण की विशेषता नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is NOT a feature of demonetisation ?

options.A: यह कम रोकड़ अथवा नकदी रहित अर्थव्यवस्था की ओर ले जाता है अर्थात् अधिक बचतों को औपचारिक वित्तीय प्रणाली की ओर दिशा प्रदान करना तथा कर अनुपालन में सुधार करना ।
options.B: इसकी व्याख्या सरकार द्वारा किए गए उस उपाय के रूप में की जाती है जो यह संकेत करता है कि कर चोरी को लंबे समय तक सहन अथवा स्वीकार नहीं किया जा सकता ।
options.C: इसे कर प्रशासन उपाय के रूप में देखा जाता है ।
options.D: कर-प्रशासन ने इसके द्वारा बचतों को औपचारिक वित्तीय प्रणाली से दूर दिशा प्रदान की है ।

options_english.A: It leads to creation of a less-cash or cash-less (free) economy i.e. channeling more savings through the formal financial system and improving tax compliance.
options_english.B: It is interpreted as a shift on the part of the government indicating that tax evasion will no longer be tolerated or accepted.
options_english.C: It is viewed as a tax administration measure.
options_english.D: It led to tax administration channelising savings away from the formal financial system.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). Demonetisation actually channels savings towards the formal financial system, not away from it. Option D states the opposite — that it channels savings away from the formal financial system — which is factually incorrect and hence NOT a feature of demonetisation. Options A, B, and C are all correct features of demonetisation as it promotes a cashless economy, signals zero tolerance for tax evasion, and is a tax administration measure.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। विमुद्रीकरण का उद्देश्य बचतों को औपचारिक वित्तीय प्रणाली की ओर लाना है, न कि दूर करना। विकल्प D गलत तथ्य प्रस्तुत करता है, इसलिए यह विमुद्रीकरण की विशेषता नहीं है।

questions.text:
समाहांत में समाइरा अपनी मित्र सना के साथ एक पिक्चर देखना चाहती थी । उन्होंने एक बटन दबाकर ऑनलाइन अपने इच्छित सिनेमाघर पर अपनी टिकटें आरक्षित कर लीं और अपनी प्राथमिकता के अनुसार सीटों का चयन किया । अब टिकटें आरक्षित करने के लिए सिनेमाघर जाना आवश्यक नहीं है ।

उपरोक्त अनुच्छेद में प्रतिबिंबित व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण का आयाम है :
questions.text_english:
Samaira and her friend, Sana wanted to watch a movie over the weekend. They booked the movie tickets online and chose the seats as per their preference at the click of a button at the desired movie hall. Now going to theatre for booking of tickets is no longer required.

The dimension of business environment reflected in the above para is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Technological environment. The ability to book movie tickets online at the click of a button represents a technological advancement that has changed how consumers access services. This reflects the technological dimension of business environment. Political environment relates to government policies, social environment relates to social values, and legal environment relates to laws and regulations.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) प्रौद्योगिकीय पर्यावरण है। ऑनलाइन टिकट बुकिंग प्रौद्योगिकी के विकास का एक उदाहरण है जो व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के प्रौद्योगिकीय आयाम को दर्शाता है।

questions.text: पायल एक बहुराष्ट्रीय कम्पनी में कार्यरत थी । उसके पिताजी ने उसे जन्मदिन पर ₹ 40,500 का एक स्मार्टफोन उपहार में दिया । यह मोबाइल फोन उसके पिताजी ने अपने एक मित्र की दुकान से खरीदा था । कुछ माह पश्चात् मोबाइल फोन में समस्याएँ उत्पन्न होने लगीं । पायल ने निर्माता से सम्पर्क स्थापित करने का बहुत बार प्रयास किया लेकिन उसने कोई जवाब नहीं दिया । अन्तत: पायल ने निर्माता के विरुद्ध शिकायत करने का निर्णय लिया । शिकायत निवारण का वह उपयुक्त तंत्र जहाँ पायल शिकायत कर सकती है, वह है :
questions.text_english: Payal was working in a Multinational company. Her father gifted her a smart phone worth ₹ 40,500 on her birthday. The mobile phone was purchased by her father from his friend's shop. After few months, the mobile phone started creating problems. Payal tried to contact the manufacturer many times but he did not respond. Ultimately Payal decided to file a complaint against the manufacturer. The appropriate grievance redressal machinery where Payal can file a complaint is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) District Forum/Commission. Under the Consumer Protection Act, complaints involving goods or services valued up to ₹1 crore are to be filed at the District Forum/Commission. The mobile phone costs ₹40,500, which is well within the District Forum's jurisdiction. State Commission handles complaints between ₹1 crore and ₹10 crore, National Commission handles above ₹10 crore, and the Supreme Court is the final appellate body.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) जिला फोरम/कमीशन है। उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम के अनुसार ₹1 करोड़ तक के मामलों की शिकायत जिला फोरम/कमीशन में की जाती है। स्मार्टफोन की कीमत ₹40,500 है जो जिला फोरम के अधिकार क्षेत्र में आती है।

questions.text: प्रतिभूतियों को इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में रखने की प्रक्रिया ________ है ।
questions.text_english: ________ is the process of holding securities in electronic form.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Dematerialisation. Dematerialisation (Demat) is the process by which physical share certificates and other securities are converted into and held in electronic form. This eliminates the risks associated with physical certificates such as theft, loss, and forgery. Financial Intermediation involves middlemen in the financial system; Allocative function refers to directing funds to productive uses; Mobilisation of securities refers to collecting savings.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) विभौतिकीकरण है। विभौतिकीकरण (डीमैट) वह प्रक्रिया है जिसमें भौतिक प्रतिभूतियों को इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में परिवर्तित करके रखा जाता है।

questions.text:
रजत प्लास्टिक के उपयोग करके फैंकने वाली वस्तुओं जैसे प्लास्टिक प्लेट, प्लास्टिक कप तथा प्लास्टिक स्ट्रॉ के निर्माणी व्यवसाय को चला रहा था । उसने एकल उपयोग प्लास्टिक पर लगने वाले आगामी प्रतिबंध के बारे में सुना । वह बाह्य पर्यावरण की इस प्रवृत्ति को पहचानने में सक्षम था जो उसकी फर्म के निष्पादन में बाधा पहुँचा सकती थी । अत: उसने तुरंत कार्यवाही की और बाँस व ताड़ के पत्तों से प्लेटें, कप तथा स्ट्रॉ विनिर्माण करने के व्यवसाय में स्थानांतरित हो गया । इसके परिणामस्वरूप उसका व्यवसाय न केवल जीवित रहा अपितु लाभ उत्पन्न करने के योग्य हो गया ।

उपरोक्त में व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के महत्त्व के जिस बिन्दु पर प्रकाश डाला गया है वह है :
questions.text_english:
Rajat was carrying on a business of manufacturing plastic disposables like plastic plates, plastic cups and plastic straws. He heard about the upcoming ban on single use plastics. He was able to identify this external environmental trend which could hinder his firm's performance. So he took action and shifted to manufacturing the plates, cups and straws from bamboo and palm leaves. As a result, his business not only survived but was able to generate profit.

The point of importance of Business Environment highlighted above is :

options.A: यह फर्म को अवसरों की पहचान करने एवं पहल करने के लाभ को प्राप्त करने के योग्य बनाता है ।
options.B: यह फर्म को खतरों की पहचान एवं समय से पहले चेतावनी देने में सहायता करता है ।
options.C: यह उपयोगी संसाधनों का दोहन करने में सहायता करता है ।
options.D: यह नियोजन एवं नीति निर्धारण में सहायता करने में मदद करता है ।

options_english.A: It enables the firm to identify opportunities and getting the first mover advantage.
options_english.B: It helps the firm to identify threats and early warning signals.
options_english.C: It helps in tapping useful resources.
options_english.D: It helps in assisting in planning and policy formulation.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B). Rajat identified the upcoming ban on single-use plastics as a threat to his business and responded with an early warning — a classic example of how understanding the business environment helps firms identify threats and take timely action. He did not discover a new opportunity for first-mover advantage (A), nor did he specifically tap resources (C) or formulate policy (D).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। रजत ने एकल उपयोग प्लास्टिक पर आने वाले प्रतिबंध को एक खतरे के रूप में समय पर पहचाना और उचित कदम उठाए। यह व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के महत्त्व का वह बिंदु है जो खतरों की पहचान एवं प्रारंभिक चेतावनी से संबंधित है।

questions.text:
कथन – I : ब्राण्ड का वह भाग जिसे बोला जा सकता है ब्रांड नाम कहलाता है ।

कथन – II : ब्राण्ड का वह भाग जिसे कानूनी संरक्षण दिया जाता है ट्रेड मार्क कहलाता है ।

निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Statement – I : That part of a brand which can be spoken is called a brand name.

Statement – II : That part of the brand which is given legal protection is called Trademark.

Choose the correct option from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन II सत्य है तथा कथन I असत्य है ।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement II is true and Statement I is false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Both the statements are true. Statement I is correct: a brand name is that part of a brand which can be spoken or vocalised, such as 'Surf Excel' or 'Amul'. Statement II is also correct: a trademark is that part of the brand that is given legal protection under the law, preventing others from using it without permission. Both definitions are accurate as per standard marketing concepts.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। ब्रांड नाम वह भाग है जिसे बोला जा सकता है और ट्रेड मार्क वह भाग है जिसे कानूनी संरक्षण प्राप्त होता है — दोनों सही परिभाषाएँ हैं।

questions.text:
नीचे दिया गया चित्र एक परफ्यूम की बोतल का पैकेज है :

ऊपर दिखाए गए पैकेजिंग के डिब्बे के स्तर की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
The picture given below is the package of a perfume bottle :

Identify the level of packaging of the box shown above :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Secondary packaging. The box shown in the image is the outer packaging that contains the perfume bottle inside it. This is secondary packaging — it is the additional layer of protection over the primary package (the perfume bottle itself). Primary packaging is the immediate container in direct contact with the product (the bottle). Transportation packaging (tertiary) is used for bulk shipment.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) द्वितीयक पैकेजिंग है। चित्र में दिखाया गया डिब्बा परफ्यूम की बोतल के बाहर का आवरण है। यह द्वितीयक पैकेजिंग है क्योंकि यह प्राथमिक पैकेज (बोतल) के ऊपर अतिरिक्त सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है।

questions.text:
अमन, आशीष एवं आशी तीन मित्रों ने एक प्रसिद्ध प्रबन्ध संस्थान से अपनी एम.बी.ए. पूरी करने के बाद 'सोल्यूशन्स' नाम से एक 'स्टार्ट अप' बनाया । स्टार्ट अप का लक्ष्य अपनी सेवाओं के माध्यम से सामाजिक एवं पर्यावरणीय प्रभाव डालना था । 'सोल्यूशन्स' मुम्बई की स्लम बस्तियों में रहने वाले लोगों की स्थिति में सुधार करने वाले सामाजिक व्यावसायिक विचारों का समर्थन करता था । चूँकि तीनों मित्रों ने सामाजिक कार्यों में विशेषज्ञता प्राप्त की हुई थी अत: उन्होंने मुम्बई की तीन अलग-अलग स्लम बस्तियों को अपनाया और अपने-अपने सृजनात्मक तरीकों से स्लम बस्तियों में रहने वाले लोगों को शिक्षित करना आरम्भ कर दिया । अमन ने 'खेल-खेल में सीखना' पद्धति का प्रयोग किया, आशीष ने 'संगीत' को एक सीखने की विधि के रूप में प्रयोग किया जबकि आशी ने 'गतिविधि आधारित सीखना विधि' का प्रयोग किया । उन्होंने आधारभूत ज्ञान का उपयोग अपने-अपने अनोखे तरीकों से किया और स्लम बस्तियों में रहने वाले लोगों को शिक्षित करने में सफल रहे ।

इसका यह तात्पर्य है कि इच्छित परिणामों को प्राप्त करने के लिए प्राप्त ज्ञान का दक्षतापूर्ण एवं व्यक्तिगत उपयोग प्रत्येक व्यक्ति में भिन्न-भिन्न होता है ।
questions.text_english:
Three friends, Aman, Ashish and Ashi after completing their MBA from a reputed management institute, formed a start up named 'Solutions'. The goal of the start up was to make a social and environmental impact through its services. 'Solutions' supports social business ideas to improve living conditions in slums of Mumbai. As all the three friends are specialised in social work, they adopted three different slums of Mumbai and started educating the slum dwellers in their own creative manner. Aman used 'playway method', Ashish used 'music' as a method of learning while Ashi used 'activity based method of learning'. They used basic knowledge in their unique manner and were able to educate the slum dwellers.

It implies that skillful and personal application of acquired knowledge varies from individual to individual in achieving desired results.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त स्थिति में चर्चित प्रबन्धन की प्रकृति को पहचानिए एवं उसका उल्लेख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify and state the nature of management discussed in the above case.

key_points: Management as an Art
Art involves application of knowledge and skills in a personalised way
Different individuals apply the same knowledge differently to achieve desired results

sub_questions.solution: The nature of management identified in the above case is 'Management as an Art'. Art involves the personalised application of knowledge and skills. Just as Aman, Ashish, and Ashi all used their management and social work knowledge but applied it in their own unique and creative ways — playway method, music, and activity-based learning respectively — this demonstrates that management, like art, requires the creative and individual application of acquired knowledge to achieve desired outcomes.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त अनुच्छेद से पंक्तियों को उद्धृत करते हुए उपरोक्त (a) में पहचानी गई प्रबन्धन की प्रकृति की किन्हीं दो विशेषताओं का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Quoting lines from the above para, state any two features of nature of management identified in (a) above.

key_points: Feature 1: Art requires the existence of theoretical knowledge — all three friends had completed MBA
Feature 2: Art involves personalised application of knowledge — each used their own unique creative methods

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following as factors affecting 'Financing Decision' :
(i) Fixed operating costs
(ii) Cash flow position of the company

key_points: Fixed operating costs: companies with high fixed costs prefer less debt to avoid high interest burden
Cash flow position: strong cash flows allow a company to service debt easily, making debt financing more feasible

sub_questions.solution:
Fixed Operating Costs: A company that already has high fixed operating costs — such as rent, salaries, and depreciation — already carries a substantial financial burden. If such a company borrows more and takes on fixed interest payments (debt financing), the total fixed obligations increase significantly, raising the financial risk. Therefore, companies with high fixed operating costs generally prefer equity financing over debt to reduce their overall financial burden.

Cash Flow Position of the Company: The cash flow position refers to the ability of a company to generate sufficient cash from its operations. A company with a strong and stable cash flow can comfortably service debt obligations (repayment of principal and interest). Therefore, companies with strong cash flows can afford to use more debt (leverage) in their capital structure. On the other hand, companies with weak or unpredictable cash flows prefer equity financing to avoid the risk of defaulting on debt repayments.

sub_questions.text_english: State any three points of difference between 'Primary Market' and 'Secondary Market'.

key_points: Primary market deals with new securities; Secondary market deals with existing securities
In Primary market, funds go to the company; in Secondary market, funds go to the seller (investor)
Primary market has no fixed location; Secondary market has a fixed place (stock exchange)

sub_questions.solution:
First, in the Primary Market, new securities are issued for the first time by companies to raise fresh capital; in the Secondary Market, already issued and existing securities are bought and sold among investors.

Second, in the Primary Market, the funds raised go directly to the issuing company; in the Secondary Market, funds flow from the buyer to the selling investor — the company receives no new funds.

Third, the Primary Market has no specific fixed location as transactions happen through investment bankers and underwriters; the Secondary Market has a physical or electronic exchange (like BSE or NSE) where trading takes place in an organised manner.

sub_questions.text_english: 'Planning and controlling are inseparable twins of management'. Explain with the help of any three points.

key_points: Planning sets the standards against which controlling measures actual performance
Controlling provides feedback that helps in revising future plans
Without planning there is no basis for controlling; without controlling plans remain mere intentions

sub_questions.solution: Planning and Controlling are rightly called inseparable twins of management for the following three reasons. First, planning sets the standards or goals, and controlling measures actual performance against those standards — without a plan, there is nothing to control. Second, the controlling process provides feedback on the degree to which plans have been achieved; this feedback helps managers revise and improve future plans, thereby creating a continuous cycle. Third, even the best plans are useless if not implemented and monitored — controlling ensures that activities conform to plans, while planning ensures there are clear objectives for controlling to evaluate. Together, they form a closed-loop system that drives the organisation toward its goals effectively.

sub_questions.text: नियंत्रण प्रक्रिया में चर्चित 'जटिल बिंदु नियंत्रण' तथा 'अपवाद द्वारा प्रबन्धन' को समझाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain 'Critical point control' and 'Management by exception' as discussed in the controlling process.

key_points: Critical Point Control: focusing control efforts on key result areas rather than checking everything
Management by Exception: bringing to management's attention only significant deviations, not minor ones

sub_questions.solution:
Critical Point Control refers to the technique of focusing control efforts on key result areas or critical points that are essential for the success of the organisation. Since it is not possible to check every activity, managers identify the critical points where deviations are most likely to occur or where the impact of deviation would be most serious. By monitoring these key areas closely, they can prevent significant failures without wasting resources on controlling trivial activities.

Management by Exception (MBE) is the principle that only significant deviations from plans — beyond a pre-set tolerance limit — should be brought to the attention of managers. Minor deviations that are within acceptable limits are handled by subordinates. This enables managers to save time for more important decisions and focus on serious problems. Only exceptional situations — those that exceed the planned limits — require managerial intervention.

sub_questions.text_english: State any four features of directing function of management.

key_points: Directing initiates action
It takes place at every level of management
It is a continuous process
It flows from top to bottom

sub_questions.solution: Four features of the Directing function of management are as follows. First, Directing initiates action — it is the function that triggers actual work; plans and organisational structures remain inactive until managers direct employees to begin their activities toward goal achievement. Second, Directing takes place at every level of management — from top-level managers giving directions to middle-level managers, to supervisors directing workers on the shop floor, the directing function is exercised throughout the entire organisational hierarchy. Third, Directing is a continuous process — it is not a one-time activity; managers must continuously guide, motivate, communicate, and lead their teams as long as the organisation functions. Fourth, Directing flows from top to bottom — it begins with top-level management directing middle-level managers, who in turn direct lower-level supervisors, who then guide the workers. This creates a chain of command throughout the organisation.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following 'Semantic barriers' to communication :
(i) Technical jargon
(ii) Body language and gesture decoding

key_points: Technical jargon: specialised language used by experts which non-experts cannot understand
Body language and gesture decoding: incorrect interpretation of non-verbal cues leading to miscommunication

sub_questions.solution:
Semantic barriers are those barriers to communication that arise from the meaning and interpretation of words, symbols, or gestures.

Technical Jargon: Specialists or professionals in certain fields develop their own technical vocabulary or jargon that is meaningful to them but may be completely unfamiliar to others. For example, a doctor using medical terminology with a patient, or an IT professional using technical programming terms with a non-technical manager, creates a communication barrier. The receiver fails to decode the message correctly, leading to confusion or misunderstanding.

Body Language and Gesture Decoding: Communication is not only verbal — a significant part of messages is conveyed through body language, facial expressions, gestures, posture, and tone of voice. If the receiver incorrectly decodes or misinterprets the sender's non-verbal cues, the intended meaning gets distorted. For example, crossing arms might be interpreted as hostility rather than mere comfort, or lack of eye contact might be seen as dishonesty rather than shyness. Such misinterpretations create semantic barriers to effective communication.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following steps of the selection process :
(i) Selection Tests
(ii) Employment Interview

key_points: Selection Tests: standardised tests to assess aptitude, intelligence, personality, and skills
Employment Interview: formal face-to-face interaction to assess candidate's suitability for the job

sub_questions.solution:
Selection Tests: Selection tests are standardised tools used to measure an applicant's qualifications, abilities, and personality traits in relation to the requirements of the job. These tests are conducted before the interview and help organisations shortlist candidates objectively. Common types include intelligence tests (measuring IQ and reasoning ability), aptitude tests (measuring potential to learn), personality tests (measuring traits like emotional stability and sociability), and trade or proficiency tests (measuring job-specific skills). Tests help eliminate unsuitable candidates at an early stage and ensure a more objective selection process.

Employment Interview: The employment interview is a formal, in-depth face-to-face interaction between the interviewer(s) and the job applicant. Its purpose is to verify information obtained from the application and tests, assess the candidate's communication skills, confidence, and suitability for the organisational culture, and give the candidate an opportunity to learn about the job and organisation. It helps the employer evaluate personality traits, attitude, and how the candidate handles pressure or unexpected questions — factors that tests alone cannot measure. The interview may be structured, unstructured, or a combination of both.

sub_questions.text_english: State any four points of importance of 'Staffing' function of management.

key_points: Helps in finding and placing the right person in the right job
Ensures optimum utilisation of human resources
Improves organisational performance
Helps in maintaining job satisfaction and morale

sub_questions.solution: Four points of importance of the Staffing function of management are as follows. First, staffing helps in finding and placing the right person in the right job at the right time — it ensures that every position in the organisation is filled by a qualified and capable individual, which is essential for achieving organisational goals. Second, it ensures the optimum utilisation of human resources by identifying the exact number and type of employees needed and avoiding both overstaffing and understaffing, thereby reducing labour costs. Third, it improves overall organisational performance since effective staffing brings in talented, skilled, and motivated employees who contribute productively to the organisation. Fourth, staffing helps in maintaining employee job satisfaction and morale by placing individuals in roles that match their qualifications and aspirations, providing growth opportunities through training, and recognising performance through promotions and rewards.

'Shanta Enterprises' was in the business of manufacturing solar panels for the last fifteen years. With their expertise now they were able to manufacture good quality solar panels at lower cost. As a result 'Shanta Enterprises' was flooded with orders and was able to generate a good profit margin.

To motivate the employees the company decided to compensate some of them for their hard work. Arvind and Yogesh, who were working on contract basis, were absorbed permanently in the company. sub_questions.text_english: Identify and explain the incentives given by Shanta Enterprises to its employees.

key_points: Job Security — Arvind and Yogesh given permanent employment
Recognition/Prize — Ekta awarded Best Employee of the Year

sub_questions.solution:
Two incentives given by Shanta Enterprises to its employees are as follows.

First, Job Security was given to Arvind and Yogesh, who were previously working on a contract basis. By absorbing them permanently in the company, Shanta Enterprises provided them with stability and security regarding their future income. Job security is a non-financial incentive that fulfils an employee's need for a stable livelihood.

Second, Recognition through an Award was given to Ekta, the R&D Head, who was awarded the 'Best Employee of the Year Award'. This is also a non-financial incentive that publicly acknowledges an employee's outstanding contribution, boosting their sense of achievement and self-worth within the organisation.

The incentive of Job Security given to Arvind and Yogesh satisfies their Safety and Security needs — the second level in Maslow's hierarchy. Permanent employment provides financial stability and protection from fear of job loss, which directly addresses the safety and security needs of employees.

The incentive of the 'Best Employee of the Year Award' given to Ekta satisfies her Esteem needs — the fourth level in Maslow's hierarchy. Esteem needs include the desire for recognition, respect, status, prestige, and achievement. Being publicly recognised with an award fulfils Ekta's need for acknowledgement of her contributions and elevates her standing within the organisation.

questions.text_english:
Explain the following factors affecting the working capital requirements of a company :
(a) Level of competition
(b) Inflation

sub_questions.text: प्रतियोगिता का स्तर
sub_questions.text_english: Level of competition

key_points: Higher competition requires more working capital — larger inventories and liberal credit terms needed

sub_questions.solution: Level of Competition: When the level of competition in the market is high, companies need to maintain larger stocks of finished goods to meet immediate customer demand and avoid stock-outs. They may also need to offer more liberal credit terms to customers to attract and retain business. Both higher inventory levels and extended credit periods increase the working capital requirements of the company. On the other hand, a firm with a monopoly or low competition can afford stricter credit terms and lower inventory levels, thereby requiring less working capital.

sub_questions.text: मुद्रास्फीति
sub_questions.text_english: Inflation

key_points: During inflation, prices rise so the same level of activity requires more working capital

sub_questions.solution: Inflation: During periods of inflation, the prices of raw materials, labour, and other inputs rise. As a result, a company needs more funds to maintain the same level of business activity — purchasing the same quantity of raw materials and maintaining the same level of stock becomes more expensive. Therefore, higher inflation leads to higher working capital requirements. Companies need to plan carefully and ensure they have adequate working capital to sustain operations without disruption during inflationary periods.

questions.solution: This question is answered through sub_questions (a) and (b).

questions.text_english: Nishi had gone to a grocery store to make routine purchases. On reaching home, as she took out Binx tomato chips packet from the bag to give it to her son, she felt that it was underweight. She checked its weight on the kitchen weighing scale and found that it weighed 60 grams whereas the label on the chips packet mentioned the weight of the packet as 100 grams. questions.text_english:
Kaysons Ltd. was a reputed company manufacturing automotive parts for electric vehicles. As the demand for the electric vehicles grew, Kaysons Ltd. needed more capital to keep up with the demand for automotive parts. Atul, the Finance Manager of Kaysons Ltd. suggested that the company should raise funds through a public issue of shares as the stock market was bullish. The Chief Executive Officer fully understood that this process of raising funds would not only reduce the managements' holding in the company but would also require considerable expenditure. Even then he agreed with the Finance Manager and the public issue of shares was made complying with the guidelines of Securities and Exchange Board of India.

Identify and state four factors affecting choice of capital structure being discussed above.

key_points: Capital market conditions (bullish stock market favoured equity issue)
Control (public issue dilutes management control)
Cost of capital (public issue involves considerable flotation expenses)
SEBI regulations (guidelines of SEBI must be complied with)

questions.solution:
Four factors affecting the choice of capital structure identified from the above case are as follows.

First, Capital Market Conditions: The Finance Manager suggested a public issue of shares because the stock market was bullish (prices rising). Favourable market conditions make it easier and more beneficial to raise funds through equity, whereas a bearish market makes debt financing more preferable. This factor influenced Kaysons Ltd. to choose equity financing.

Second, Desire to Retain Control: The CEO acknowledged that a public issue of shares would reduce management's holding and thereby dilute management control over the company. This is an important factor — companies that wish to retain control prefer debt over equity, since debenture holders do not have voting rights.

Third, Cost of Financing: The CEO was also aware that raising funds through a public issue would involve considerable expenditure (flotation costs such as underwriting fees, advertising, legal costs). Higher costs reduce the attractiveness of equity financing, though in this case they still proceeded.

Fourth, Legal and Regulatory Factors / SEBI Guidelines: The public issue was made in compliance with SEBI guidelines. Regulatory requirements, legal framework, and compliance obligations are important factors that influence both the method and feasibility of raising capital through the capital market.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following types of plans :
(i) Strategy
(ii) Method
(iii) Budget

key_points: Strategy: a comprehensive plan for achieving long-term objectives in a competitive environment
Method: prescribes the specific manner and sequence of steps to carry out an activity
Budget: a financial plan that expresses expected results in numerical terms for a future period

sub_questions.solution:
Strategy: A strategy is a comprehensive and integrated plan designed to achieve an organisation's long-term objectives in the context of its external competitive environment. It provides the direction of the organisation's actions and specifies how resources will be deployed to attain goals. Strategies take into account opportunities and threats in the external environment as well as the internal strengths and weaknesses of the organisation. For example, a company may adopt a strategy of market penetration to increase its market share by reducing prices.

Method: A method is a prescribed, systematic way of performing a specific task or activity. It prescribes the manner in which a routine activity is to be carried out — including the exact sequence of steps to be followed. Methods are more specific than procedures and deal with a single task. For example, the method for installing a machine part may specify the exact order of steps, tools to be used, and safety precautions to be followed. Methods ensure consistency and efficiency in operations.

Budget: A budget is a single-use plan that expresses the expected results of a future period in numerical or financial terms. It is a quantitative statement of expected income and expenditure, assets and liabilities, or inflows and outflows of funds over a specified period. Budgets serve as both planning tools (setting targets) and control tools (comparing actual performance against budgeted figures). Common types include sales budgets, production budgets, cash budgets, and capital expenditure budgets.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following limitations of planning function of management :
(i) Planning may not work in a dynamic environment.
(ii) Planning leads to rigidity.
(iii) Planning is time consuming.

key_points: Dynamic environment: plans made in advance may become irrelevant due to rapid changes
Rigidity: employees may feel bound to follow plans even when circumstances change
Time consuming: gathering data and making forecasts take considerable time

sub_questions.solution:
Three limitations of the planning function of management are as follows.

Planning may not work in a dynamic environment: Planning is based on forecasts and assumptions about the future, but the business environment is constantly changing due to factors like changing government policies, technological innovations, market conditions, and competitive pressures. When conditions change rapidly, even well-thought-out plans can quickly become outdated and irrelevant. Managers who rigidly follow plans in such environments may fail to respond appropriately to new challenges and opportunities.

Planning leads to rigidity: Once plans are drawn up, they create a tendency in the organisation to follow a fixed course of action. Employees may hesitate to deviate from the plan even when circumstances demand flexibility and adaptation. This rigidity can prevent the organisation from exploring better alternatives and can reduce the creative and innovative responses of employees to changing situations.

Planning is time consuming: Effective planning requires gathering extensive data, analysing information, making accurate forecasts, and evaluating multiple alternatives before finalising a course of action. This process is both time-intensive and resource-intensive. In situations requiring quick decisions and immediate action, the time spent on elaborate planning may delay responses. Moreover, by the time the plan is ready, the situation may have already changed, making the plan less relevant or effective.

अंकुर सचदेवा ने आई टी बी विश्वविद्यालय से अपनी एम बी ए की है । वह वैज्ञानिक प्रबन्धन के अपने ज्ञान को उसके द्वारा स्थापित फास्ट फूड रेस्टरां 'काॉफी बीन' में उपयोग में लाना चाहता था । यह रेस्टरां मेन्यू के एक भाग के रूप में बर्गरस्, फ्राइस और शेक्स इत्यादि परोस रहा था ।

आजकल लोग गुणवत्ता के बारे में बहुत सचेत हैं अत: वह मानकीकृत कच्चा माल, प्रक्रियाएँ, विधियाँ, कार्य दशाएँ, मशीन इत्यादि का उपयोग कर रहा था । उद्देश्य था उत्कृष्टता के मानक स्थापित करना । ऐसा करके वह न केवल लागत में कमी करने में सफल रहा अपितु बर्गरस्, फ्राइस तथा शेक्स की नई किस्में प्रदान करने में भी सफल रहा और इस प्रकार व्यापार की मात्रा बढ़ गई ।

अंकुर सचदेवा इस बात में विश्वास रखता था कि कुशलता को बढ़ाने के लिए केवल एक सर्वश्रेष्ठ विधि होती है । जिसके परिणामस्वरूप उसने बर्गरस् को ग्रिल करने, फ्राइस को पकाने तथा शेक्स तैयार करने की सर्वश्रेष्ठ विधियाँ विकसित कीं । उसका मुख्य उद्देश्य था ग्राहकों की संतुष्टि को अधिकतम करना, जो उसने प्राप्त कर लिया ।

न केवल अपने कार्य को सर्वश्रेष्ठ तरीके से करना सीखना अपितु कुशलतापूर्वक अपने कायों का निष्पादन करने के लिए 'काॉफी बीन्स' नियमित रूप से प्रशिक्षण एवं विकास कायों में विनियोजित करती है ताकि कर्मचारियों को आवश्यक ज्ञान एवं कौशल से सुसज्जित किया जा सके । 'काॉफी बीन्स' विश्वास करती है कि कुशल कर्मचारी अधिक उत्पादन करेंगे और अधिक आय अर्जित करेंगे । इससे कम्पनी एवं कर्मचारी दोनों के लिए अधिकतम कार्यकुशलता एवं समृद्धि सुनिश्चित होगी ।

उपरोक्त स्थिति में 'काॉफी बीन्स' द्वारा उपयोग में लाए गए वैज्ञानिक प्रबन्धन के सिद्धान्तों एवं तकनीकों पर प्रकाश डाला गया है । ऐसे किसी एक सिद्धान्त एवं दो तकनीकों को समझाइए ।
questions.text_english:
Ankur Sachdeva did his MBA from ITB University. He decided to apply his knowledge of scientific management in the fast food restaurant chain 'Coffee Bean' set up by him. This restaurant was providing burgers, fries, shakes etc. as a part of its menu.

Now a days people are quality conscious, so he was using standardised raw materials, processes, methods, working conditions, machinery etc. The objective was to establish standards of excellence. By doing this he was not only able to reduce the cost but was also able to provide new varieties of burgers, fries and shakes leading to increased turnover.

Ankur Sachdeva also believed that there was only one best method to maximise efficiency. As a result he developed best way of grilling burgers, cooking fries and preparing shakes. His main objective was to maximise the satisfaction of customers, which he was able to achieve.

Not only to learn the best way of doing a job, but to perform their tasks efficiently, 'Coffee Bean' regularly invests in training and development programmes to equip employees with the necessary skill and knowledge. 'Coffee Bean' believed that efficient employees will produce more and earn more. This will ensure their greatest efficiency and prosperity for both company and workers.

The above case highlights the use of Scientific principles and techniques by 'Coffee Bean'. Explain any one such principle and two techniques.

key_points: Principle: Science, not rule of thumb — one best method developed for each task
Technique 1: Standardisation — standardised materials, methods, conditions, and machinery
Technique 2: Scientific Task Setting / Time and Motion Study — developing the best way to perform each task

questions.solution:
Principle — Science, Not Rule of Thumb: F.W. Taylor advocated replacing old rule-of-thumb methods with scientifically determined methods. Ankur Sachdeva applied this principle by believing that there is only one best method to maximise efficiency for each task. Instead of allowing workers to use any method they personally preferred, he scientifically developed the best way of grilling burgers, cooking fries, and preparing shakes. This scientific approach minimised waste, reduced time, and maximised customer satisfaction — exactly the objective of replacing guesswork with science.

Technique 1 — Standardisation: Standardisation involves establishing standards for every aspect of work — materials, processes, methods, working conditions, machinery, and tools — so that results are consistent and excellence can be achieved. Ankur used standardised raw materials, processes, methods, and machinery at Coffee Bean. This ensured uniform quality of burgers, fries, and shakes, reduced costs, and enabled the business to maintain high standards across all operations.

Technique 2 — Scientific Task Setting (Time and Motion Study): Taylor advocated that the time and motion study should be used to determine the most efficient way to perform each task. At Coffee Bean, Ankur developed the best method for each food preparation task — the best way to grill burgers, cook fries, and prepare shakes. Additionally, Coffee Bean invested in training and development programmes to equip workers with the scientifically determined best methods. Taylor believed that efficient employees working with the best methods would produce more and earn more, ensuring maximum efficiency and prosperity for both the organisation and its workers — exactly what Coffee Bean practised.
questions.topic: Taylor's Scientific Management — Principles and Techniques

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following functions of marketing :
(i) Marketing Planning
(ii) Branding
(iii) Pricing

key_points: Marketing Planning: developing a roadmap for achieving marketing objectives
Branding: giving a distinct identity to a product through a name, symbol, or design
Pricing: determining the price of a product based on cost, demand, competition, and objectives

sub_questions.solution:
Marketing Planning: Marketing planning involves developing a comprehensive plan for achieving the marketing objectives of an organisation. It includes analysing market opportunities, understanding target customers, identifying competition, setting marketing goals, and designing strategies for the marketing mix (product, price, place, and promotion). A good marketing plan ensures that limited resources are deployed efficiently, that marketing activities are co-ordinated, and that the organisation can adapt to market changes. It serves as a roadmap for all marketing activities.

Branding: Branding is the process of giving a product a distinct identity through the use of a brand name, symbol, logo, or design that distinguishes it from competing products. A brand builds customer recognition and loyalty, enables premium pricing, and makes advertising more effective. Components of a brand include the brand name (the part that can be spoken, like 'Amul'), brand mark (the visual symbol), and trademark (the part given legal protection). Branding helps companies build a long-term relationship with customers and creates a source of competitive advantage.

Pricing: Pricing refers to the process of determining the price at which a product will be sold in the market. It is one of the most critical elements of the marketing mix since price directly affects demand, revenue, profitability, and market position. Factors that influence pricing decisions include cost of production, demand conditions, competition, customer perception of value, government regulations, and company objectives (such as market skimming, market penetration, or profit maximisation). Setting the right price is essential to attract customers while ensuring profitability.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain 'Advertising', 'Sales Promotion' and 'Public Relations' as elements of promotion mix.

key_points: Advertising: paid, non-personal mass communication through media
Sales Promotion: short-term incentive techniques to stimulate immediate purchases
Public Relations: managing the company's image and goodwill with various stakeholders

sub_questions.solution:
Advertising: Advertising is any paid, non-personal presentation and promotion of ideas, goods, or services by an identified sponsor through various media such as television, radio, newspapers, magazines, hoardings, and the internet. It is the most widely used promotional tool because it can reach a large, geographically dispersed audience at a relatively low cost per person. Advertising creates brand awareness, builds brand image, informs potential customers about product features, and stimulates demand. It allows the marketer to control the message and repeat it consistently. However, it is impersonal and cannot directly respond to customer queries.

Sales Promotion: Sales promotion includes all short-term incentive techniques designed to stimulate immediate or increased purchase of a product by consumers or trade members. Common sales promotion tools include free samples, coupons, discounts, rebates, contests, buy-one-get-one offers, and scratch cards. Sales promotion supplements advertising and personal selling by providing an immediate incentive to buy. It is particularly useful during product launches, in competitive markets, or to clear excess inventory. Unlike advertising, sales promotion creates urgency and encourages quick action.

Public Relations: Public relations (PR) is the process of managing the organisation's relationships and communications with its various publics — including customers, employees, shareholders, government, and the community — to build and maintain a favourable image and goodwill. PR activities include press releases, press conferences, sponsorship of events, community service, and handling media inquiries. Unlike advertising, PR is often perceived as more credible since the endorsement comes from third parties like journalists or community groups. PR helps organisations recover from negative publicity and builds long-term brand trust.

questions.text_english: Preeti started her own cooking channel on Youtube 'Mood Art'. As her subscribers increased, she was not in a position to manage everything on her own. She hired Rahul and Riya to help her with filming, editing, lighting and content research. She granted authority to them to operate within prescribed limits. sub_questions.solution: The concept of management used by Preeti is Delegation of Authority. She hired Rahul and Riya, granted them authority to operate within prescribed limits, and thereby freed herself to focus on high-priority activities and objectives — which is the essence of delegation.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त (a) में पहचानी गई अवधारणा के महत्त्व के किन्हीं पाँच बिन्दुओं को समझाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any five point of importance of the concept identified in (a) above.

key_points: Enables managers to concentrate on high-priority activities
Promotes employee development and initiative
Facilitates quick decision making
Helps in achieving targets and organisational growth
Builds trust and motivation among subordinates

sub_questions.solution:
Five points of importance of Delegation of Authority are as follows.
